messages:
Maya: Morning—trying to pick a Saturday vibe: slow gravel ride to the pier (≈30mi) or the open-mic at Little Station at 8pm? Both sound great. Anyone up for either? :bike: :microphone:

Ajay: I’m down for the ride if we roll at 7:30. gotta pump tires and check lights. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: Open-mic is tempting — I can bring a tiny cajon and some shakers. Also, who’s up for doughnuts after? :doughnut:

Sofia: Vote: open-mic + doughnuts. If you do the ride, I’ll meet you for a picnic later instead. :raised_hands:

Maya: Nice split. @Ajay 7:30 works for me. @Taylor bring the percussion. @Sofia picnic noted — I’ll grab a blanket.

Taylor: If weather looks bad, fallback plan = coffee + boardgames at my place. (I have an extra table for cards) Link to place: http://maps.example/cafe — tiny patio.

Maya: Quick emoji poll to decide energy: react with :bike: for ride, :microphone: for open-mic, :game_die: for boardgames.

DevOps Bot: Reminder: office bike rack reservation expires Sat 09:00 — please move bikes to overflow if you’re leaving them all day. :robot_face:

Ajay: :bike: (I can swing by open-mic later if we need another vocalist)

Sofia: :microphone: (and yep doughnuts pls)

Taylor: :game_die: (I’ll bring Codenames and a small speaker)

Maya: Looks delightfully split. I’ll DM logistics and a quick packing checklist. Anyone who wants my sunrise playlist can run: play "Sunrise Loam" on Spotify or grab this share: https://open.example/playlist/abcd

Ajay: sweet. see y’all Sat — early crew for the pier ride, evening crew for the mic, hybrid welcome. :raised_hands:
